line: Commander, this is the Pyramid Overlord, a walking pyramid fortress that hunts the middle layers beside its station. Four Energy Conduits feed its shield. Destroy them first, and it takes our full fire.

Commander, the Orbital Devourer is a world-eater that never stops moving. It roams the whole galaxy on its own path, hunting just above the worlds. Catch it where it is, and strike with our heaviest ships.
Commander, the Void Warden is a void core caged in plated rings and horned crescents. It guards the deep layers near the Core. Send a strong fleet, and bring our allies.
Commander, this Energy Conduit is one of four crystal pylons feeding the Overlord's shield. Bring all four down, and the Overlord takes full damage.

Commander, the Brood Matriarch is the Hive's queen. She nests in the Far Reach, and the worlds around her turn green as her infection spreads. Her swarm rebuilds while she's left alone, so keep up the attack.

Commander, the Iron Tyrant is a pirate super-dreadnought patched together from stolen hulls. It sails from hideout to hideout, and its vault fills the longer it sails. The later we hit it, the richer the bounty.
Commander, the Event Horizon Wyrm is a serpent of black-hole rings, coiled around the black hole at the centre of the galaxy. Only its glowing segments can be hurt, so strike while they're exposed.
Commander, the Shard Colossus is a crystal golem grown out of the crystal fields. Badly hurt, it shatters into fragments that shield it, but it pays Void Shards in bulk.
